body:
## Why

Consumer sync PR stranske/Trend_Model_Project#6035 carried resolved Copilot review threads on manifest-synced scripts. The upstream source in this repository needed focused tests so later sync regeneration could preserve the corrected behavior.

## Scope

Add focused unit tests in Workflows for the exact-head/observer filtering path in `agents_pr_meta_update_body.js` and confirm the fenced/commented-checkbox coverage in `issue_scope_parser.js`.

## Non-Goals

- Changing the consumer PR directly; fixes land in Workflows main and propagate via sync.
- Altering production behavior beyond what the existing code already implements.

## Tasks

- [x] In `.github/scripts/__tests__/agents-pr-meta-update-body.test.js`, add mocked API coverage for the exact-head/observer filtering path in `.github/scripts/agents_pr_meta_update_body.js`: exact-head filtering, a pending dependency-contract run falling back to its last completed result, and direct Gate recovery.
- [x] In `.github/scripts/__tests__/issue_scope_parser.test.js`, verify focused tests cover a checkbox outside the managed status block exactly once and ignore checkboxes inside fenced code or multiline HTML comments. This coverage already existed on the selected base from #3441 and was re-run for this delivery.
- [x] Run `./scripts/sync_templates.sh`; both source scripts are manifest-synced and the template copies were already aligned. A second sync was idempotent.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/agents-pr-meta-update-body.test.js` passes (89 tests), including the new exact-head/observer filtering cases.
- [x] `node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/issue_scope_parser.test.js` passes (52 tests), including the existing fenced/commented-checkbox cases against root and template copies.
- [x] `node --test .github/scripts/__tests__/*.test.js` passes (1,685 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed).
- [x] `python -m pytest -q tests/scripts/test_workflow_pr_context_audit.py` passes (28 tests).
- [x] `./scripts/sync_templates.sh`, `python scripts/validate_template_sync.py`, and `python scripts/validate_template_completeness.py` pass; a second sync is idempotent.
- [x] **Deliberate-break gate:** removing the exact-head filter made `collectStatusWorkflowRuns keeps only exact-head non-observer runs` fail with stale run id 12 replacing exact-head id 11; restoring the filter returned the suite to green.

## Implementation Notes

Ready-for-review PR #3578 carries the missing workflow-status API coverage. The original Trend_Model_Project #6035 review threads and the later Portable-Alpha-Extension-Model #2305 threads are resolved; this delivery preserves the requested upstream regression coverage without changing production behavior.
